refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.MachineInstance is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.MachineInstance
# Forcefully terminate the machine immediately method Terminate() -> ()
# Request a clean shutdown of the machine method PowerOff() -> ()
# Reboot the machine method Reboot() -> ()
# Pause/freeze the machine method Pause() -> ()
# Resume a paused machine method Resume() -> ()
# Query the current status of the machine method Describe() -> ( # True iff vCPUs are executing running: bool, # Backend-specific state string (e.g. 'running', 'paused', 'shutdown'); 'unknown' if unavailable status: string )
# Subscribe to machine events. Returns a stream of events as they occur. # [Requires 'more' flag] method SubscribeEvents( # If specified, only deliver events whose name matches one of these strings; null means all events filter: ?[]string ) -> ( # Name of the event event: string, # Event-specific payload data: ?object )
# Attach a storage volume (passed via file descriptor) to the running machine method AddStorage( # Index of the attached file descriptor for the storage volume fileDescriptorIndex: int, # Caller-supplied identifier for this binding (any non-empty string; machinectl uses '<provider>:<volume>' from the StorageProvider, but the form is not required) name: string, # Backend-specific configuration config: ?string ) -> ()
# Detach a previously-attached storage volume from the running machine method RemoveStorage( # Identifier of the binding to detach (as supplied to AddStorage) name: string ) -> ()
# Replace the backing of a previously-attached storage volume in place method ReplaceStorage( # Index of the attached file descriptor for the new backing storage fileDescriptorIndex: int, # Identifier of the existing binding whose backing is being replaced (as supplied to AddStorage) name: string ) -> ()
# The connection to the machine backend is not available error NotConnected()
# The requested operation is not supported error NotSupported()
# The named storage binding does not exist error NoSuchStorage()
# A storage binding with this name already exists error StorageExists()
# The storage binding cannot be detached at runtime (e.g. attached at boot) error StorageImmutable()
# The supplied 'config' value is not valid for this backend error BadConfig()
# The supplied 'config' value is recognized but not supported by this backend error ConfigNotSupported()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.MachineInstance shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.MachineInstance.Terminate '{}' invokes its Terminate() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.MachineInstance interface was added in version 261.

AddStorage(), BadConfig, ConfigNotSupported, Describe(), NoSuchStorage, NotConnected, NotSupported, Pause(), PowerOff(), Reboot(), RemoveStorage(), ReplaceStorage(), Resume(), StorageExists, StorageImmutable, SubscribeEvents(), and Terminate() were added in version 261.
